conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Hello, main Manisha Reddy. Mere demat account mein shares nahi dikh rahe.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Manisha ji, main aapki madad karoonga. Kya aap apna demat account number bata sakti hain?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Haan, yeh hai D M 7 8 9 4 5 6 1 2 3. Maine kal hi kuch shares kharide the.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Main check karta hoon. Lagta hai shares T+2 settlement ke wajah se abhi reflect nahi hue. Kal tak dikh jayenge.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Achha, yeh T+2 kya hota hai?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Yeh stock market ka settlement period hai, jisme 2 din lagte hain. Main aapko iske baare mein details mail karta hoon. Theek hai?
